item.title: 'Not going to stop until I find him': First Nation man's family search for more remains in Ontario murder case
item.description: Ontario Provincial Police have stopped looking for the rest of Mekhi Pelly’s remains as two people face charges in the murder case, but the Kenora-area man's family vows to keep searching. Here's what we know about the investigation as a range of people, including from Manitoba, help in the search.
